captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bicycle track floor pump. It features a tripod base with three dark gray or black rectangular feet, a tall cylindrical main barrel in a vibrant red finish, and a black T-shaped handle at the top. A black pressure gauge is attached near the bottom of the barrel, and a flexible black hose loops from the mid-barrel down to the base. The T-handle is attached to a metallic silver pump rod that slides vertically (prismatically) in and out of the red barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a bicycle track floor pump using CadQuery. The design must feature a tripod base with three radial feet, a tall red cylindrical barrel, a lower pressure gauge, a flexible hose loop, and a black T-handle connected to a central rod that slides prismatically along the vertical axis of the barrel.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base assembly with three radial legs spaced at 120-degree intervals using rectangular box primitives. The central barrel is built from a red cylinder capped by a black top cap and a lower collar. A pressure gauge is modeled as a small horizontal cylinder with a white face, and a hose is swept or approximated along a path on one side. The handle assembly is modeled separately as a metallic rod cylinder connected to a perpendicular black T-bar handle, which is then linked to the main body via a prismatic joint along the Z-axis.
